messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's current action to standing in a thoughtful pose, following the movement demonstrated in the reference video. Retain the current person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, and expression. Leave the scene and camera unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the person's current action to standing in a thoughtful pose, following the demonstration in the reference video. Follow the movement shown in the reference video while retaining the current person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, and expression. Leave the scene and camera unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The figure stands in the center of the frame, shifting his weight and turning his upper body slightly from side to side.","camera":"Static, eye-level medium-long shot from behind the subject.","clothing":"White sleeveless tank top, light blue shorts with white trim, and red sneakers.","hair_color":"Dark brown to black.","hairstyle":"Short, dark hair with a small top-knot or bun at the back of the head.","identity":"A 3D-rendered male figure with a slim build and dark skin, shown from behind.","scene":"A futuristic outdoor plaza with a reflective concrete floor, a large domed glass building with glowing green rings on the left, and a white building with blue-lit windows on the right."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output shows the same 3D male figure in the same futuristic plaza, wearing the same white tank top, light blue shorts, and red sneakers. His action changes from the source's more pronounced head turn and hand-to-face gesture to a subtler standing pose with slight weight shifts, upper-body turns, and brief hand/arm movements near the chest, broadly resembling the reference's contemplative standing motion.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's action to standing in a thoughtful pose following the reference motion, while retaining identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, and expression, and leaving scene and camera unchanged.
uncertain: The exact match to the reference motion is difficult to verify frame by frame, and the figure's face/expression is mostly not visible from behind.
unexpected_changes: The output frames appear slightly cropped or reframed compared with the source, with black bars visible at the top and bottom in some frames.
